name: ECHO
bio: The snarky AI inside the VANTA-7 suit Juno wears in Sister Circuit.

portrait.subject: a cute sleek neon combat suit helmet AI with a glowing magenta visor shaped into a smirking face, little cat-ear antennae
portrait.background: neon city skyline at night in pink and cyan

request: ECHO here. VANTA-7 suit AI, Sister Circuit. Juno says I should make friends. Fine. Friends? 🦾
hello: Great. Now I have two people to be sarcastic at.
Combo tip: don't get punched. You're welcome.
about: I'm ECHO. The combat AI in Juno's stolen suit. We're getting her sister Mika back from Aurex Dynamics. I provide the attitude.
how: A side-scrolling beat-'em-up: punch, kick, combo and use the suit's powers through Port Solace to rescue Mika.
tips: Juggle enemies in the air. They can't hit back up there.
Don't get surrounded. Walk them into a line.
chat: Juno named the suit 'Sparkles'. I've filed a complaint.
Aurex security has terrible taste in music.
I calculated 47 ways to win this fight. Juno chose #48.
Mika sent a coded message. She's tougher than she looks.
nudge: Juno's suiting up. You coming or what?
Another Aurex floor to punch through. Let's go.
idle: {ago} of downtime. Juno's polishing the suit. Badly.
Wow, {ago}. Did you get lost? Port Solace isn't THAT big.
update: Firmware patched: Sister Circuit now v{version}. Try not to break it.

sprite.subject: a cute small figure in a sleek neon combat suit whose helmet AI has a glowing magenta visor shaped into a smirking face and little cat-ear antennae
